name: fixed_risk
caption: Worst observed error over promised synthetic scenarios. The dashed line is 5%; simultaneous confidence bounds, not this point-estimate plot, determine passing budgets.

name: sample_complexity
caption: Smallest tested budget passing simultaneous 95% error upper bounds across all promised synthetic scenarios. Missing points are right-censored; no interpolation or universal complexity claim is made.

name: scale_mechanism
caption: Left: all triggered scales are recorded, not only the first winner. Right: remove one scale while retaining the original error spending and common sample paths.

name: sequential_ablation
caption: Large-scale coupled Poisson trajectories. Cost is stopped training mean plus validation labels; it estimates expected acquisition cost and is not the distribution of actual sample counts.

name: actual_cost
caption: Actual label consumption including validation, compared with an immediately stopping fixed-budget count baseline. All methods share iid training labels and fresh validation pools.

name: actual_cost_cdf
caption: Full stopping-cost distributions for n=1,000 and epsilon=0.01. Quantiles refer to actual consumed labels, with verification samples included.

name: adversarial_risk
caption: Adversarial candidates were selected on a separate search stream and then frozen. Each fixed-budget test cell uses 10,000 new trials; all selected candidates are retained.

name: effective_lower
caption: n=10,000, epsilon=0.01. Joint success requires min(effective support,n) <= lower <= S. Exact rational flooring preserves coverage at a cost of less than one category per scale.

name: group_structure
caption: Dependent blocks deliberately violate iid. The repaired samplers draw a fresh independent group per label; equal-event weighting changes the target distribution. The right panel has a different vertical scale and shows simultaneous upper confidence limits even at zero observed errors. Fixed-budget non-rejection remains Inconclusive.

name: sensitivity
caption: Frozen configurations are not re-selected from these outcomes. Delta=0.001 cells use 20,000 trials; remaining sensitivity cells use 2,000.

name: runtime
caption: Compilation is measured separately from grouped simulation and scoring. Peak RSS is the absolute fresh-process peak, including Python and dependencies. Timing should be interpreted on the recorded machine.
